text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the prohibition of parking from 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m. along portions of Stonehenge Crescent and Mountland Drive as a means to limit overnight parking abuses. Currently three-hour maximum parking is permitted.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking on both sides of Stonehenge Crescent, from 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m., between Mountland Drive (west intersection) and a point 174 metres north. 2. Prohibited parking on both sides of Mountland Drive, from 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m., between Carew Gate and Mornington Gate.
